description: The response time of an HTTP request to a given url, tagged by url, e.g. 'url:http://example.com'. Also tagged by http_status_code when enable_status_code_tag is set.
Whether the check can connect, 1 if true, 0 otherwise. Tagged by url, e.g. 'url:http://example.com'. Also tagged by http_status_code when enable_status_code_tag is set.
Whether the check failed to connect, 1 if true, 0 otherwise. Tagged by url, e.g. 'url:http://example.com'. Also tagged by http_status_code when enable_status_code_tag is set.
